traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements for story 010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT are fully implemented and verified: - @supports format is parsed and validated by dedicated helpers used by valid-annotation-format, including strict format checks. - valid-req-reference performs deep validation of each @supports requirement ID against the specified story file, with requirement IDs scoped per story file and storyPath included in error messages. - Existing @story + @req annotations remain fully supported, and mixed usage of @story/@req/@supports in the same codebase and comments is covered by both implementation and tests. - Multiple test suites explicitly reference this story and its requirements, and all of them pass in the current Jest run. - User-facing migration documentation includes clear examples and guidance for adopting @supports alongside legacy annotations.
Based on the current repository state and test results, this story is fully satisfied.
